process_issue: Closed-won to onboarding handoff is missing SLA discipline.
affected_accounts: Beacon Hiring Co; Cloudforge Labs; Quartz Education Group
suggested_fix: Create a same-day closed-won handoff checklist and kickoff scheduling rule.
expected_impact: Reduces lost context immediately after close.

process_issue: Blockers are recorded but not converted into unblock plans.
affected_accounts: Beacon Hiring Co; Cloudforge Labs; DeltaOps Systems; Evergreen Clinic Group; Finley Finance Studio; Grove Robotics; Horizon Analytics; Ivory Desk Software; plus 11 more
suggested_fix: Turn every blocker into owner, due date, and escalation path.

affected_accounts: Beacon Hiring Co; Cloudforge Labs; Finley Finance Studio; Ivory Desk Software; Northstar Legal Ops; Quartz Education Group; TerraWorks Energy
suggested_fix: Make training a tracked activation milestone with customer attendance.

process_issue: Customer communication is going stale during onboarding.
affected_accounts: Cloudforge Labs; Finley Finance Studio; Kinetic Support Labs; Northstar Legal Ops; Prairie Foods Network; Quartz Education Group; Riverline Logistics; TerraWorks Energy; plus 1 more
suggested_fix: Add a weekly customer touchpoint SLA and stale-account review.
expected_impact: Prevents silence from turning into churn risk.

process_issue: Owner coverage is unclear across onboarding, CS, and implementation.
affected_accounts: Cloudforge Labs; Quartz Education Group; TerraWorks Energy
suggested_fix: Require named owners before kickoff and during every stage change.

process_issue: Next steps are too vague to manage.
suggested_fix: Require every account to have a dated next action with one owner.

process_issue: Technical integration blockers are slowing activation.
affected_accounts: DeltaOps Systems; Kinetic Support Labs; Meridian Robotics; Riverline Logistics; Vertex Mining Analytics
suggested_fix: Create integration runbook with customer technical owner and internal owner.

process_issue: Data migration ownership and source data readiness are weak.
affected_accounts: Evergreen Clinic Group; Northstar Legal Ops; UniScale Marketplaces
suggested_fix: Use a migration readiness checklist before kickoff.

process_issue: Accounts are not converting onboarding activity into product usage.
affected_accounts: Finley Finance Studio; Kinetic Support Labs; Luma Retail Cloud; Prairie Foods Network
suggested_fix: Tie activation criteria to usage evidence and run adoption recovery.

process_issue: Activation dates are slipping without earlier intervention.
affected_accounts: Juniper BioTools; Kinetic Support Labs; Meridian Robotics; Northstar Legal Ops; Prairie Foods Network; Quartz Education Group; Riverline Logistics; TerraWorks Energy; plus 1 more
suggested_fix: Review accounts 7 days before target activation and reset milestone plans.

process_issue: Billing risk is leaking into onboarding.
suggested_fix: Add finance review to onboarding risk meeting for unpaid accounts.

process_issue: High-value onboarding risk is not escalated early enough.
affected_accounts: Meridian Robotics; Prairie Foods Network; Riverline Logistics; TerraWorks Energy
suggested_fix: Add automatic founder review for high-value accounts with high risk.
